'''Activation Energizers''' were components used in [[Stun net/Legends|stun net]] [[Net gun/Legends|launchers]]. The Energizer wrapped around the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] of the weapon, located between the [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] and the [[Net Accelerator]].<ref name="EGWT" />
